items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to eye contact, body language, personal space, Darwin's NVC theory, and Yuki's emoticon study.

items.title: GCSE Psychology: Language, Thought and Communication — Sapir-Whorf Hypothesis
items.description: Study-with-Me GCSE podcast covering the full Language, Thought and Communication unit — includes the NVC content alongside language and animal communication.

items.title: Explaining Non-Verbal Behaviour: Innate (GCSE AQA Psychology)
items.description: AQA GCSE-targeted video explaining Darwin's evolutionary view that NVC behaviours such as facial expressions are innate and universal.

items.title: Explaining Non-Verbal Behaviour: Learned — Yuki (GCSE AQA Psychology)
items.description: AQA GCSE video on Yuki's emoticon study showing that facial expressions are interpreted differently across cultures, supporting the learned view.

items.title: Your Body Language May Shape Who You Are | Amy Cuddy | TED
items.description: Famous TED Talk on how posture and body language affect both how others perceive us and how we feel about ourselves — note replication debate is ongoing.

items.title: Reading Body Language Like an Expert — Science of Non-Verbal Communication (Full Documentary)
items.description: Full documentary featuring expert psychologists explaining the signals humans send through posture, gesture, eye contact, and personal space.

items.title: The Mentalist
items.description: Crime drama featuring a consultant who uses expert observation of NVC — eye contact, micro-expressions, and body language — to solve cases.

items.title: BBC Bitesize — AQA GCSE Psychology
items.description: Bitesize hub with revision content on non-verbal communication, Darwin's theory, and Yuki's cross-cultural emoticon study.

items.title: AQA GCSE Psychology specification
items.description: Official AQA spec — check the exact NVC bullet points required, including types of NVC and the innate versus learned debate.
